exp2.detail: extraIV1 = alerting cue (Alter cue vs No cue). Task column added 2026-09 (default self-matching); study-specific extraIV columns renamed to extraIV1/extraIV2 (semantics above); redundant/derived columns removed (raw keeps originals). Auditory component = 100 ms alerting beep (task-irrelevant warning cue), presented within the 200-250 ms blank after the 500 ms fixation on half of the trials; trial timeline: fixation 500 ms -> blank 200-250 ms (beep on half of the trials) -> shape-label pair 100 ms -> response window 1000 ms (source: REF/Qian_2020_QJEP_DS.md, Exp2 Method and Figure 1). Modality set to "Audiovisual" 2026-10 (was "Visual and Auditory").
